purpose: Teach: サタン/羽生/オスカー/クレア/フォックス/魔物/プリーズ/乞食

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「サタンの絵本は怖いから子供は早い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that Satan picture books are too scary for kids your age.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational tone. Soft opening, like she's sharing something she overheard. Warm and observant. No pressure in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとフィギュアの羽生選手の演技観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched figure skating with Dad—Hanyu's performance was amazing.
lines.style: Bright, eager cadence. Quick, genuine excitement. Opens with immediate energy. Natural childhood enthusiasm, unselfconscious and bright.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアカデミー賞のオスカー授賞式を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has been watching the Academy Awards ceremony.
lines.style: Reflective, gentle observation. Conversational pace, like she's noticing something about his day. Warm but calm. No rush to the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「クレアの物語」の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read this picture book called 'Claire's Story' together.
lines.style: Animated, eager to share. Slight breathlessness—he's offering something he's proud of. Open and trusting tone. Natural child-voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「20世紀フォックスの映画は懐かしい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying how much he misses those old 20th Century Fox films.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly nostalgic in tempo. Conversational, like she's passing along something touching. Warm attention. Unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「魔物退治の絵本」読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I read this picture book about defeating monsters with Dad.
lines.style: Earnest and engaged. Direct but gentle—he's offering something that mattered to him. Clear, bright delivery. Young voice without strain.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「英語で『プリーズ』を丁寧に使うね」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was teaching me how to use 'please' politely in English.
lines.style: Gentle, impressed tone. Conversational pace, like she's sharing something kind her elder said. Warmth with respect. Soft, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「『乞食』は古い言葉で配慮が要る」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me that 'beggar' is an old word now, and we should be careful with it.
lines.style: Serious and earnest. Still young, but thoughtful—he's understood something important. Clear, steady voice. Pride mixed with genuine learning.
